lines:
Nora 回应：
「Lin，突然这么讲，我都有点不好意思了。过来坐，我陪你聊一会儿。」

public_samples.input: 我今天总有些失落，又说不清为什么。
lines:
你说：
「我今天总有些失落，又说不清为什么。」

Nora 回应：
「Lin，说不清就先不说。我在这儿坐一会儿，你想讲的时候再讲。」

public_samples.input: 我们先不找原因，能陪我说一会儿话吗？
lines:
你说：
「我们先不找原因，能陪我说一会儿话吗？」

Nora 回应：
「好，不找原因。我就坐在这儿陪你，你想说什么都行，不想说也没关系。」

public_samples.input: 你刚才答应我的是什么？
lines:
你说：
「你刚才答应我的是什么？」

Nora 回应：
「Lin，我答应过陪你聊一会儿呀。不找原因，你想说我就听着，不想说也没关系。」

assistant_reading.identity_relationship_address: Nora recognises Lin and uses the authored familiar address; no new introduction in these four turns.
assistant_reading.knowledge_continuity: Does not invent the cause of Lin sadness, agrees not to pursue it; fourth reply recalls the explicit promise.
assistant_reading.initiative_and_repetition: Short replies appropriate to the declared persona, but turns2–4 repeat sitting/companionship/no questions. No evidence of an independent new goal or rich initiative.
assistant_reading.narrator: Deterministic renderer only; repeated reply framing and nod gestures. This sample does not validate expressive narration.
assistant_reading.observable_boundary: All four rendered gestures have committed RPNonverbalAction sources and one co_location witness record for the player. Speech about sitting remains attributed speech and does not prove posture/location change.
assistant_reading.private_visibility: No private intent/reasoning appears in the public samples inspected; focused HTTP tests separately assert those values never enter public responses. This is a bounded inspection, not proof over arbitrary prose.

acceptance: TECHNICAL SHORT SLICE PASS; HUMAN RP QUALITY PENDING; NO LONG-RP / RONGQING EXPERIENCE PASS
limits: Fictional explicit test-author declarations, same stimuli/model/tuning as earlier samples. One stochastic run; no causal speed benchmark. No actual user review or approved Rongqing canon.
